cards.name: Sailor of Means
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

cards.name: Sail into the West
cards.oracleText: Will of the council — Starting with you, each player votes for return or embark. If return gets more votes, each player returns up to two cards from their graveyard to their hand, then you exile Sail into the West. If embark gets more votes or the vote is tied, each player may discard their hand and draw seven cards.

cards.name: Sailors' Bane
cards.oracleText:
